newsitem.title: UK: Russian seaborne crude exports fall in Aug - Petrak.
newsitem.headline: Russian seaborne crude exports fall in Aug - Petrak.

text.p: Russian seaborne crude exports fell slightly in August from July as lower shipments from Novorossiisk and Odessa more than cancelled out higher volumes from other ports, shipping inspectors Petrak said on Thursday.

Crude exports from the four ports in August totalled 1.256 million barrels per day (bpd), 30,000 bpd fewer than in July but still 35,000 bpd above the average for the first eight months of 1996, Petrak said.
Russia's leading Black Sea port of Novorossiisk shipped 629,123 bpd in August against 677,041 bpd in July.
Odessa shipped 202,677 bpd, down 21,290 bpd on July, while Tuapse saw exports increase from 94,199 bpd to 98,111 bpd in August.
August exports from the Latvian Baltic port of Ventspils totalled 326,088 bpd, sharply up from 291,407 bpd in July, Petrak said.
